comments.author: acidphantasm
comments.body_html:
Due to an issue in SPT your quest naming convention is going to cause issues. As soon as you finish “themachine_1” everything after “themachine_10” is going to become available and locked due to how SPT looks for new quests based on completion. Anything that contains “themachine_1” will show up after finishing the first quest. This would be fixed by renaming quests that require a quest that contains “themachine_1” such as renaming “themachine_11” to “themachine__11” by adding in an extra underscore, or just use MongoIDs.

In addition to this - Questing Bots will prevent users from loading into a raid due to recursion happening with “AvailableForStart” condition requirements on “themachine_6” - it’s requiring “themachine_15” which also requires “themachine_6” due to dependency. This looks like a typo but would be the cause of people failing to load raids with QuestingBots.
